name: No Safe Harbour
choreography: Compact shoulder-loaded hook into a maximal two-handed horizontal spear thrust. Reel the target through a hip-led pull, rising hook jerk at43, advance into a second drive at74 and a short final thrust at96. Return spear to shoulder and recover offhand knife. Long teal hook wake reads the full narrow reach.
requirements: One spear, unchanged hook shape and hand grips
White controlled-volume hair and blue sports glasses
Largest hook displacement at first active
Native near and tip hit, mirrored, block, distance miss and airborne miss
